message: Schema designed and migration script created. Data model covers all required entities, supports estimated values and category grouping. Ready for review.

T002 complete. Built snapshot entry flow: (1) Database utilities with SQLite schema auto-initialization, (2) API routes for tracked items and snapshots (full CRUD), (3) SnapshotForm component with value entry, actual/estimated toggles, live net worth calculation, (4) Minimal page showing last snapshot summary + new snapshot form. Scope kept tight — no history view or dashboard features.
